name: Assurance game
summary: A two-player trust dilemma where mutual cooperation yields the best payoff but defection is safer.
rules_text: Each of two players simultaneously chooses to Cooperate (hunt stag / invest) or Defect (hunt rabbit / don't invest). Payoffs satisfy a > c >= d > b for Player 1 and w > x >= z > y for Player 2, where a,w is the mutual-Cooperate reward, d,z is mutual-Defect, and b,x and c,y are the mixed outcomes. Mutual cooperation is payoff-dominant and Pareto optimal. Mutual defection is risk-dominant and safer. Players reveal choices together and receive corresponding payoffs. Played once, or repeated for a fixed number of rounds with cumulative scoring.
rating_reason: Stag Hunt payoff matrix, classic strategic game
